GD PERSONAL WCAG VERIFICATION CHECKLIST
For every new color added to MCM

STEP 1 - Identify token and use context
- What CSS variable name?
- Text / background / border / icon / graph element?
- Smallest text size (check all usage sites)
- Normal (<18px non-bold) needs 4.5:1. Large text needs 3:1.

STEP 2 - Collect all background candidates
- Main bg (--bg, --color-bg)
- Card bg (--color-card or component bg)
- Any overlay or modal bg
- Dark mode override if applicable

STEP 3 - Calculate ratio per pair
For each fg+bg pair: hex | L | ratio | pass/fail

STEP 4 - Adjacent element check
Run the two fg colors against each other if they must be distinguishable.

STEP 5 - Focus ring (interactive elements)
Focus ring contrast >= 3:1 against adjacent bg (WCAG 2.2).

STEP 6 - Both themes
Light and dark mode pass/fail.

STEP 7 - Reduced opacity
Blend alpha against bg, recalculate.

STEP 8 - Append to audit log
date | token | fg-hex | bg-hex | ratio | pass/fail | action

WORKED EXAMPLE (fd-text-3)
Step 1: normal text, 0.73rem -> need 4.5:1
Step 2: fd-card #161b22, fd-bg #0d1117
Step 3: #6E7681 on #161b22 = 3.77 FAIL; on #0d1117 = 4.12 FAIL
Fix: #7E8895: on #161b22 = 4.81 PASS; on #0d1117 = 5.27 PASS
Step 8: logged, filed to FD inbox (20260222-1026-from-GD-fd-text-3-wcag-fail.json)

WHY THIS: I skipped Step 2 when auditing FD tokens. I checked the value but not all bg contexts. This checklist closes that gap. GF can automate a node script using Step 8 output as test fixtures.
subject: GD Task 8 output - Personal WCAG verification checklist
